values.note: Wright County residents: electric (50-amp, water) $32, full service $35 a night; non-residents $40 and $43. Tandem sites $51 resident / $61 non-resident. $6 non-refundable reservation fee. Cancelling costs $15 a site 14+ days out, $20 at 7-13 days, $25 within 6 days.

fees.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Bertram-Chain-of-Lakes-Regional-Park-52 ('Electric Campsite (50 amp service/Water): $32 per night for Residents Wright County, $40 per night for Non-Residents', 'Full Service Campsite... $35... $43', 'A $6 reservation fee applies') + campground map PDF (tandem rates, cancellation penalties), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Book online (Wright County WebTrac) or through the park office, (763) 295-0409. Four same-day sites (6, 12, 13, 14) are reserved by calling the office. 2026: RV site reservations opened March 2. The 7-night limit runs Memorial Day to Labor Day, then 48 hours off the property; outside that window the manager can allow longer stays. Check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Bertram-Chain-of-Lakes-Regional-Park-52 ('Camping is limited to a maximum of 7 consecutive nights', 'RV Campsites open for reservation on Monday, March 2, 2026 for the 2026 season', online reservations link) + map PDF ('Four (4) sites are same day reservation sites. You must call the Park Office', legend 'Same Day Reservation' sites 6/12/13/14, rule 17), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026 camping season May 1 - October 18. Camper cabins are open year-round.
All 38 sites have 50-amp electric and water; 24 also have sewer.

hookups.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Bertram-Chain-of-Lakes-Regional-Park-52 ('Of the 38 RV sites, 24 of them are full-service sites with 50-amp electrical service, water, and sewer hook ups. The remaining 14 sites have 50-amp electrical service and water hook ups'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Bertram-Chain-of-Lakes-Regional-Park-52 ('a modern campground with 38 RV sites and 6 camper cabins'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/DocumentCenter/View/30514 (map legend and symbols: Restroom, Shower, RV Dump Station) + facility page ('There is a bathroom and shower available at the contact station'), read 2026-11-11

note: Wright County campground in Bertram Chain of Lakes Regional Park (owned with the City of Monticello), on four non-motorized lakes with a swim beach, trails and a chalet; six camper cabins. Long Lake lies south of the cabins, not beside the RV loops. --Claude
summary: County facility page and campground map PDF read: 38 sites (24 full service, 14 electric+water, all 50-amp), resident $32/$35 (non-resident +$8), $6 reservation fee, WebTrac online booking plus 4 same-day sites by phone, 7-night limit in summer, 2026 season May 1-Oct 18, showers and dump. Base corrected 40 -> 32 (the resident rate, per the schema). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: Fees changed: nightly_low 40 -> 32 and nightly_high 40 -> 35. The stored $40 was the non-resident electric rate; the base is the Wright County resident rate, with non-residents recorded as a +$8/night surcharge ($40 / $43).

Missing phone: the park office, (763) 295-0409 (facility page and map PDF: 'For reservations, call the Park Office at (763) 295-0409'). The county page also lists 763-682-7693 (Wright County Parks & Recreation main office).

Website: both stored URLs answer 200 and are this park. The county's own page (wrightcountymn.gov ...Details/Bertram-Chain-of-Lakes-Regional-Park-52) is the operator's; the Monticello page is the co-owner's. Wright County runs the campground.
Waterfront: confirmed not waterfront. On the county map and imagery the RV loops sit north of the park road; Long Lake is 150 m+ south beyond the cabins and a tree band.
Pin 45.29634,-93.84777 is at the campground entrance/contact station; the loops are centred about 190 m NE (about 45.2972,-93.8458). Under 250 m, no move needed.
Note cleaned: dropped site counts, hookups, the 7-night max and the reservation fee (fields hold them).
